title: From Reporters to Robots: How AI is Reshaping Journalism
description: AI is used in journalism for automated reporting, fact-checking, newsroom support, personalisation, and the trust problem no tool can hand-wave away.
short_description: A grounded guide to automated reporting, fact-checking, newsroom pressure, platform incentives, and the trust problem journalism cannot dodge.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: Readers who want a grounded, non-technical view of AI in journalism, including journalists, editors, platform teams, and readers tracking information systems.
